author: Ankit
problem: The string 'wbwbwwbwbwbw' repeats forever. Read W and B and print Yes if some contiguous piece of it has exactly W 'w's and B 'b's, otherwise No.
bug_description: Slices wball[i:W+B+1] (a fixed end) instead of wball[i:i+W+B], so the windows have the wrong length and only start near the beginning.

comments.accurate: Tries every window of length W + B in the repeated pattern and checks its w and b counts
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks the slices from each start position up to index W + B of the repeated pattern
comments.wrong_location: Window slice verified; check that the pattern is repeated enough times for W + B = 200

source.buggy_line: if wball[i:(W+B+1)].count('w') == W and wball[i:(W+B+1)].count('b') == B:
source.fixed_line: if wball[i:(i+W+B)].count('w') == W and wball[i:(i+W+B)].count('b') == B:
